note: Historical issue/key routing only; current consumer anchors and dispositions are in outcome-matrix.md. All listed keys verified present in current en.json; no final copy copied or drafted.

issues.state: Status request failed or timed out while server may already have verified the message.
issues.action: Current copy directs manual Check status; no automatic recovery occurs after failure.
issues.mechanism_gap: Preserve genuinely unknown proof result; separately settle bounded system-owned polling/recovery versus intentional manual retry. A rendered check button alone is not the decision.

issues.state: Known HTTP rejection, malformed response, provider/internal send failure or unknown operation outcome share broad messages.
issues.action: Generic try again/check connection/resend may not match the classified cause or receipt/delivery uncertainty.
issues.mechanism_gap: Operation-aware known/unknown outcome and supported recovery contract must precede copy. Do not infer no activation or no delivery from fallback classification.

issues.state: Receiver offline or email capability unavailable.
issues.action: Wait for return/try again shortly without an implemented recovery notification; receiver polling pauses.
issues.mechanism_gap: Define what restores service state and who acts. Preserve no-resend instruction; do not turn visible retry controls into mandatory customer work or promise short recovery.

issues.state: Current phone binding and legacy simulated verification outcomes coexist.
issues.action: Finish registration remains explicit today; trial retry screens are not production policy authority.
issues.mechanism_gap: T010 owns eliminating redundant post-registration/claim confirmations and resumable context; do not silently approve current manual mechanics merely by retaining labels.

issues.state: Identity refresh, quantity mutation or incompatible-cart failure.
issues.action: Retry/change/resolve instructions lack consistent retained-context and known-outcome handling.
issues.mechanism_gap: Keep same-account context and distinguish known rejection from uncertain mutation; define supported incompatible-cart recovery before copy.

issues.state: Purchase, guest admission and invitation entry describe current optional registration.
issues.action: Extra completion/claim clicks and name assignments coexist with owner-required registration and automatic continuation.
issues.mechanism_gap: T001 owns self/gift binding; T010 owns required existing/new-account journey and redundant-confirmation removal. Wording alone cannot implement that contract.

issues.state: Missing/malformed bearer, lost mounted context or failed claim response.
issues.action: Current generic error guesses expired/claimed/account conflict and directs buyer contact; refresh/redirect can lose bearer.
issues.mechanism_gap: Consume typed known/unknown domain outcomes and same-account successful-result recovery. Do not expose other claimant data or recommend token rotation as universal remedy.

issues.state: Admission save/link issuance error or locked row.
issues.action: Refresh/check/support language does not fit every cause or preserve private issued links.
issues.mechanism_gap: Split actor/action/outcome states and settle name-correction authority separately from reassignment.

issues.state: Payment preparation, return, lookup or confirmation unresolved.
issues.action: Customer is told to check/retry while broad catches hide known account/review causes or precede durable attempt storage.
issues.mechanism_gap: T004 owns automatic bounded reconciliation and retained same-attempt/account context, never automatic payment launch; no financial copy-only retry rewrite.

issues.state: Legacy payment return accepts missing or invalid paymentId and collapses resume/status outcomes.
issues.action: No reference/unknown result/admission-review wording is not cause-specific.
issues.mechanism_gap: Legacy result route is reachable, not dormant like TicketSelection; coordinate its migration/classification with current commerce financial authority.

issues.state: Settings account displays phone/email state and purported communication use.
issues.action: Any stored phone appears MMS verified; phone purpose promises event announcements.
issues.mechanism_gap: Render trusted verification/binding state and validate actual communication/consent purposes. A stored phone is not verification, identity or age proof.
